UPSC preparation demands long hours at a desk, but physical health deserves attention, too.

LevelUp IAS organised a special session on Posture, Pain & Movement During UPSC Preparation, featuring Dr. Rachita Luthra, a musculoskeletal physiotherapist, in conversation with Sonali Medhekar-Sheth, Counselling Psychologist and UPSC Mindset Coach.

The session covered posture, practical exercises and common physical concerns faced by aspirants. Students also shared their experiences, highlighting how the discussion helped address their doubts and gave them useful exercises to practise during study hours.

Watch the highlights and hear why making time for physical well-being matters during UPSC preparation.
